Chorus | ONSITE (Hybrid): Mountain View, Boulder, Austin | chorusview.com/careers

The physical world needs a digital voice. Chorus launched from Alphabet's Moonshot Factory last year with a mission to change how the worlds goods are made, moved, and managed. Our team is a collection of experts spanning hardware, firmware, software, data and ML/AI. We're building the world's first hyper-scalable asset orchestration platform. We have a solid strategy, investors, customers, partners, and many exciting things to build!

Roles:

Lead Full Stack Engineer: build beautiful, intuitive UX from database to browser.

Sr. Backend Engineer: build the platform that will help us 1000x, TWICE.

Sr. Data Engineer: build platforms that make data valuable, fast, and efficient.

Sr. Data Scientist: build data-intensive apps that unleash the story in the data.
